messages.subject: For Ahmed Mohamed Janahi | Airport infrastructure, government partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ahmed Mohamed Janahi, Chief Executive Officer of Bahrain Airport Company.

Bahrain International Airport's role as a national gateway requires disciplined alignment across government, aviation authorities, airlines, commercial partners and infrastructure stakeholders. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and airport stakeholder strategy might support Bahrain Airport Company's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Bahrain Airport Company.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
